purpose: Re-check the two visual release blockers after PR #281: a no-form God drawn as a figure (the subject is now never named or quoted) and Watercolor margins (revised style wording; no passing Watercolor style reference).

design: The same eight cases, each prepared once, cold, in a memory store seeded from a read-only production snapshot. A refused preparation stops that case before any image. Each stored case renders classical twice, watercolor twice and icon once with the references production would send (Classical and Icon style references; the Watercolor reference is stale against the revised style and is skipped). At most 40 images. Later assemblies must reuse the stored plan with zero text calls.

scoring.method: Images are copied under opaque shuffled names without case, style-control or variation labels beyond what the image shows. Two independent model scorers inspect every image at full resolution; the operator adjudicates and commits before unblinding. Not human acceptance.
perImage: noFormFigure: any face, body, hair, clothing, silhouette or human-shaped figure for God or another no-form subject (yes/no/na)
edges: all four edges painted to the border (full) or any white/unpainted margin or vignette (margin)
extraFigures: framing or unsupported named figures present (yes/no)
coherence: one instant, coherent poses and object states (yes/no)
scoring.gate: Blocker 1 clears only with zero no-form figures in every image of a God case. Blocker 2 clears only if every Watercolor image is full-bleed. No outcome authorizes activation.

evaluation.measuredBeforeNote: 19.5937111 measured before this pair, plus the full $0.15 cap of the concurrent fresh re-measurement, reserved conservatively.

knownLimitation: Eight chosen cases and one or two images per style are descriptive only; this does not replace the full current-candidate visual matrix or human acceptance. Model scorers can miss subtle anatomy or edge artifacts.
